notes: Coverage limit: the web search budget ran out before a fresh sweep of 2025-26 bills in most states. none cells rest on the Leadership Conference Education Fund trackers (research current to Sept 2023; report updated Oct 2024; 2025 page lists 13 states) plus spot checks. Laws enacted after mid-2025 may be missing.

Hawaii: the Oct 2023 Zellers review counts HB1983/SB811 as a law requiring subgroup categories, but enacted Act 136 (2023) only created a task force. The Oct 2024 update of Disaggregation Nation removed Hawaii from its list. Rated partial.

No pending cells: no bill alive in the 2025-26 cycle was confirmed for a non-enacted state. Texas SB 2390/HB 3564 sat in committee after 3/25/2025. Washington SB 5784 was in Senate Ways & Means on 11/2/2026, but Washington is already enacted.

California: AB 2132 was named in the task but not found in any source read. The subgroup statutes trace to AB 1088 (2011, Gov. Code 8310.5 and 8310.7) and AB 1726 (2016, adds CDPH). The Leadership Conference calls 8310.7 a '2022 law'; CDPH cites AB 1726 with a July 1, 2022 start date.

New York: year entered as 2021 (signed Dec 2021, amended by a 2022 chapter amendment). The Leadership Conference cites 'Chapter 18' of the Laws of New York; I did not verify the chapter number. A separate MENA law (Exec. Law 170-h) is not an Asian/NHPI measure.
Minnesota: Zellers describes the law as applying to 'certain school districts'; current Minn. Stat. 120B.35 subd. 3 text applies to the commissioner's reporting categories generally.

Connecticut: the statute (PA 21-35 Sec. 11) defers to OHS subgroup standards. The OHS web page now carries a notice that agency functions were realigned under PA 26-68 effective 6/30/2026; I did not verify what happened to the standards.

Vermont is unclear: 18 V.S.A. 253 requires race/ethnicity health data disaggregated beyond White/non-White, per a recommendation I could not find. Illinois, Nevada and New York 170-h add MENA categories, which are not counted as Asian/NHPI disaggregation.

New York quote was copied from the NewYork.Public.Law mirror when first read; the mirror returned HTTP 503 on a later automated re-check, so the quote could not be re-matched. The 2021 bill text (A6896A) is the primary source.

Not reachable from this environment: wearethedata.us (D-DAN interactive map), leginfo.legislature.ca.gov, nysenate.gov and ilga.gov via curl. Mirrors (California.Public.Law, NewYork.Public.Law, OregonLaws) were used for current code text and are marked non-primary.
